prompts.he-face-parts-v2:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: eight reusable FACE-ONLY expression layers for He Ming's two existing whole-body portraits. The input image is the exact anatomical and lighting reference.
Generate a transparent 1536x1024 atlas with exactly 4 columns and 2 rows, eight equal 384x512 cells. Each cell contains ONLY the central facial skin and expression features of this same man, at the same size, angle and eye line: forehead below the hairline, both eyebrows, both eyes, nose, cheeks, lips. Exclude hair, ears, jaw silhouette, chin silhouette, neck, shoulders and clothing entirely. The outer edge of each face patch tapers softly into true alpha, especially the forehead and cheeks. These are image compositing layers, not masks or objects.
Match the input face's exact identity, age, skin tone, lighting, three-quarter view and feature spacing. Fixed head pose and camera across all eight; do not turn, tilt, lift or stretch the face. Only expression changes. All cells have the same aligned eyebrow/eye/nose/mouth positions. Place the facial patch in each cell inside x=75..309 and y=95..365, with generous transparent margin.
Row 1 left to right: neutral, focused, lighthearted restrained smile, doubtful with closed lips and a slight questioning brow.
Row 2 left to right: restrained anger, tired with slightly lowered eyelids, emotionally touched with a small softened smile, determined.
No open-mouth shock, no exaggerated deformation, no wounded expression, no gore, no neck, no head outline, no added scenery, no glow, no labels, no tile borders. Preserve his natural wrinkles. Do not generate complete heads or new full-body portraits. True alpha transparency.
